messages.subject: unexpected exit after deploying updated app
parts:
Dear forum,

I've run into a problem after deploying (some relatively minor) updates to a Shiny app that was previously working. Although the app works fine running locally in my browser, after deployment to shinyapps.io, I get the following error message:

The application unexpectedly exited.

Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console

The errors in the console are:

Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 (Internal Server Error) https://nsmader.shinyapps.io/cps-compare-pairs-elem/_w_7bdeedd755b9bc23eb4c07702f55bd4ae9658fe9cf2d31f6/shared/selectize/css/selectize.bootstrap2.css
Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 (Internal Server Error) https://nsmader.shinyapps.io/cps-compare-pairs-elem/_w_7bdeedd755b9bc23eb4c07702f55bd4ae9658fe9cf2d31f6/shared/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css
Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 (Internal Server Error) https://nsmader.shinyapps.io/cps-compare-pairs-elem/_w_7bdeedd755b9bc23eb4c…2f55bd4ae9658fe9cf2d31f6/shared/bootstrap/css/bootstrap-responsive.min.css

Thoughts on what the cause might be (given my limited understanding of the loading processes for CSS elements), and how to address it?

Thanks!
Nick
